description: Needs a free Parse sign-in, which this call asks the person for: the person's own brand's brief (what changed, what to do next) and their work record. Call it only when the person wants their own brand, tracking or their record, or says yes to an offer; for any public question use check_brand and the other tools.

brand.description: the brd_ id of the brand this job is for, in a workspace that serves several (an agency's clients): the brief is about it, nobody is asked which brand is theirs, and nothing is claimed or billed

chains.description: add the common jobs, each as its chain of calls (always added while the workspace has no brand)

moves.description: add every brand of the workspace (its own and those it watches), each in its own markets, this week against the week before, largest move first: $0.005, one read for all

peek.description: read the brief without marking it read, so the next call (this key's or another's) still starts where the last read did

since.description: "last" (default: since the last brief) or an ISO date or time

name: get_brief
title: Get the brief
